name: Herrstein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of blue with a narrow white pale, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Herrstein (a red and white chequy field above blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Herrstein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herrstein arms — chequy above blue and white
